This application involves semiconductor integrated circuit.The power consumption of semiconductor integrated circuit is reduced, and reduces the delays in work in semiconductor integrated circuit.The multiple sequence circuits being included in storage circuit include respectively：Transistor, the channel formation region of the transistor are formed using oxide semiconductor；And capacitor, an electrode of the capacitor are electrically connected to when the transistor cutoff as the node of quick condition.By the channel formation region that oxide semiconductor is used for transistor, it is possible to achieve the minimum transistor of off state current (leakage current).Therefore, by making the transistor cutoff in during not supplying supply voltage to storage circuit, the current potential of the node being electrically connected with an electrode of capacitor in this period can be remained constant or constant.As a result, it is possible to achieve above-mentioned purpose.

Technical field

The present invention relates to a kind of semiconductor integrated circuit.Especially, should be partly the present invention relates to a kind of semiconductor integrated circuit Conductor integrated circuit, which includes the storage circuit with sequence circuit, can simultaneously control the supply voltage supplied to the storage circuit (can To carry out power gating (power gating)).

Background technology

The scale of semiconductor integrated circuit including logic circuit expands year by year.In the early stage of development of integrated circuit, integrate Circuit is made of several elements.Now with the central processing unit (CPU being made of several ten million elements：Central Processing Unit) and digital signal processor (DSP：Digital Signal Processor).Although pass through element Micromation and lower voltage reduce the power consumption of each element, but because parts number further increases, integrated circuit Overall power consumption is increasing.As the method for reducing power consumption, to partly stopping the Clock gating (clock of clock Gating the method for), reducing clock frequency and the method for partly reducing supply voltage are researched and developed.

Power consumption not only includes the dynamic power due to discharge and recharge etc. caused by the switching of the element as transistor etc., and And including the static power due to the leakage current under the cut-off state of the element etc..Although integrated including a small number of elements In circuit the static power can substantially ignore no matter, but static state work(in the integrated circuit of the element including vast number Rate is too big and cannot ignore.Therefore, control has been developed and supply voltage is fed to the side for including circuit in integrated circuits Method (power gating).This method can lower the power consumption due to leakage current.

For example, patent document 1 discloses a kind of semiconductor integrated circuit that can carry out power gating.Specifically, specially Sharp document 1 discloses a kind of semiconductor integrated circuit, the semiconductor integrated circuit be included in logic circuit and power supply line it Between transistor, and can by control the switching of the transistor control to the logic circuit supply supply voltage.

The content of the invention

But when the logic circuit includes storage circuit (register when) being made of multiple sequence circuits, it is stored Data due to carry out power gating and be wiped free of.In fact, the known logic included by existing semiconductor integrated circuit Usually using the storage circuit of register etc. in circuit, and power gating causes the erasing of stored data.In this situation Under, when starting again to storage circuit supply supply voltage, it is necessary to carry out arithmetical operation etc. again.That is similar calculation Art computing needs to carry out twice.Therefore, by the decreased effectiveness for the reduction power consumption for carrying out power gating acquisition.Further, since The work of the semiconductor integrated circuit cannot be started again at untill completing the arithmetical operation, so this can integrate semiconductor The delays in work of circuit.

In view of the above problems, the first purpose of one embodiment of the present invention is to reduce the power consumption of semiconductor integrated circuit. One embodiment of the present invention another object is that reduce semiconductor integrated circuit in delays in work.Note that one of the present invention The purpose of mode be realize it is at least one in above-mentioned purpose.

It can realize in the following way at least one in above-mentioned purpose.The multiple sequential electricity being included in storage circuit Road includes respectively：Transistor, the channel formation region of the transistor are formed using oxide semiconductor；And capacitor, the capacitance One electrode of device is electrically connected to when the transistor cutoff as the node of quick condition.The band gap of the oxide semiconductor It is wider than the band gap of silicon, and the intrinsic carrier density of the oxide semiconductor is lower than the intrinsic carrier density of silicon.Passing through will This oxide semiconductor is used for the channel formation region of transistor, it is possible to achieve off state current (off-state current) (is let out Leakage current) few transistor.Therefore, by cutting the transistor in during not supplying supply voltage to storage circuit Only, the current potential of the node being electrically connected with an electrode of capacitor in this period can be remained constant or constant. As a result, arithmetical operation etc. need not be carried out again when starting again at and supplying supply voltage to storage circuit.That is in basis In the semiconductor integrated circuit of one embodiment of the present invention, there is no the power consumption and work produced due to the arithmetical operation again Work postpones, therefore can realize above-mentioned purpose.
